sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Polish: faster title/home, less background load, Kodik history, offline banner

- Title page fills each block as soon as it arrives, Shikimori data in
  parallel, recent titles cached in memory, retry and pull-to-refresh
- Home shows the last snapshot instantly and refreshes at most every 15 min
- App foreground work throttled: bookmark sync 10 min, Shikimori import and
  notification rescheduling 6 h (manual refresh still immediate)
- Spotlight re-indexes only when the set of titles changes; playback
  positions capped at the 3000 most recent
- Bookmark order is stable across syncs
- Kodik episodes are recorded in history and marked watched when moving on
- Offline banner with a shortcut to downloads; light haptics
